items.title: Actual proximal estimator: stability in both inputs

source.anchor: Lemma 4.2 equations (4.4)-(4.5); definition (3.2), normalized C2/Hessian setting (1.1)
source.attribution: Samplinglib exposition of Fan Chen, Sinho Chewi, Jianfeng Lu and Matthew S. Zhang's input-stability estimates; an explicitly restricted constructed-oracle proof component, not the full lemma.

items.statement: There exists a measurable map p:E→E with p(y)+eta∇V(p(y))=y. For every y,z it satisfies F_y(p(y))+((kappa^-1+eta^-1)/2)||z-p(y)||² <= F_y(z), and F_y(z)<=F_y(p(y)) iff z=p(y). The map p is 1-Lipschitz. For the actual estimator ĝ_eta(y;G)=∇V(p(y)+sqrt(eta)G), the position-input difference is at most ||y-y'|| and the noise-input difference is at most sqrt(eta)||G-G'||.
assumptions: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra; dimension zero is allowed.
V:E→R is genuinely twice continuously Frechet differentiable; kappa is a nonnegative real with kappa>=1. For every x,v, kappa^-1 ||v||^2 <= D²V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2 (normalized beta=1).
Fix 0<eta<=1/2. Set F_y(x)=V(x)+||x-y||²/(2 eta). All y,y',G,G' are arbitrary deterministic vectors. No Gaussian-law or integrability hypothesis is used for these pointwise inequalities.

formulae.label: Pointwise input stability
formulae.tex: \widehat g_\eta(y;G)=\nabla V(p(y)+\sqrt\eta G),\quad\|\widehat g_\eta(y;G)-\widehat g_\eta(y';G)\|\le\|y-y'\|,\quad\|\widehat g_\eta(y;G)-\widehat g_\eta(y;G')\|\le\sqrt\eta\|G-G'\|.

bindings.boundary: Partial coverage of (4.4)-(4.5) for 0<eta<=1/2, inherited from the existing constructor, not a necessary mathematical threshold or a source repair. Finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces, including dimension zero, are a coordinate-free extension. No estimator bias, centered exponential moment, smoothed score, Picard accuracy, initialization or query-cost conclusion.

assumption_deltas.lean: E is a finite-dimensional complete real inner-product space with its Borel sigma algebra; dimension zero is allowed.
assumption_deltas.reason: Coordinate-free finite-dimensional argument includes the zero-dimensional case, not an infinite-dimensional claim.

assumption_deltas.source: Normalized C2 potential with Hessian between kappa^-1 and1, kappa>=1.
assumption_deltas.lean: V:E→R is genuinely twice continuously Frechet differentiable; kappa is a nonnegative real with kappa>=1. For every x,v, kappa^-1 ||v||^2 <= D²V(x)[v,v] <= ||v||^2 (normalized beta=1).
assumption_deltas.reason: ContDiff guarantees genuine derivatives; totalized gradient values are not substituted for differentiability.

assumption_deltas.source: The two pointwise estimates are not limited by a eta<=1/2 threshold.
assumption_deltas.reason: Inherited from the existing actual measurable constructor, not necessary for the private nonexpansiveness argument and not a source correction.

assumption_deltas.source: p(y) is the actual proximal minimizer.
assumption_deltas.lean: Constructed measurable p with genuine optimality equation and quantitative unique-minimum certificate.
assumption_deltas.reason: Existence, measurability and identification are reused from the same parent rather than supplied as assumptions.

assumption_deltas.lean: All inputs are arbitrary deterministic E vectors.
assumption_deltas.reason: Gaussianity, integrability and expectation are irrelevant to these two pathwise assertions.

assumption_deltas.source: Lemma 4.2 additionally includes bias and centered exponential moments.
assumption_deltas.lean: Only the two deterministic input-stability edges.
assumption_deltas.reason: No full-lemma, score bias, concentration, Picard or paper completion is claimed.
